author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: data_q uses a registered same-domain enable and a contracted synchronous reset on clk_a. There is no gated clock (CDC-020/CDC-045) and no crossing (CDC-028). Class settled to Clock and reset interaction (Reader B, author): the case is a synchronous clock-enable and reset lookalike for clock-control hazards.

author_reading.rationale: Pure synchronous clock-enable pipeline in one clock domain with synchronous reset and no clock gating or muxing.

labels.rationale: The enable and payload are registered in the consumer domain. Reset is synchronous, and the conditional data capture does not gate the clock.
All registers (pipe_en_q, stage_in_q, data_q) use posedge clk_a directly with a synchronous clock enable (pipe_en_q) and synchronous reset (sync_rst_ni), and all ports are constrained to clk_a.
